name: starling-monorepo
description: Starling — one goal in, a murmuration of open-weight coding agents out.

scripts.test: bun run test:packages && bun run test:web
scripts.test:packages: echo '── bun test: packages apps/server apps/cli skills integrations tools evals ──' && bun test packages apps/server apps/cli skills integrations tools evals
scripts.test:web: echo '── bun test: apps/web (separate process — happy-dom owns the global fetch) ──' && cd apps/web && bun test
scripts.typecheck: for d in packages/* apps/*; do tsc --noEmit -p "$d/tsconfig.json" || exit 1; done
